messages:
maya: Quick check — I'm stewarding the 11:30 micro-release for inference-service. Pushing a KV-cache hotfix + a small quantization profile tweak. No DB migrations. Who's on smoke and who will own rollback?
omar: I can take smoke. Will run the smoke playbook and validate p90 latency. @linh want to pair on logs?
linh: Yup, I'll tail logs and check traces. Will verify kv_cache hit-rate + batch sizing.
sam: Quick Q — rollback steps? Is the image pinned and what's the exact command?
maya: Image is pinned. Rollback (if needed) is: ```kubectl set image deployment/inference inference=redwood/inference:stable-20260306 --record``` No infra changes. We can rollforward to the canary tag after investigating.
omar: Smoke plan I'll follow: 1) smoke-http-check 2) sample prompt run (10 requests) 3) tail infra logs for errors 4) perf dashboard quick-check. I'll start at 11:35 and ping here.
linh: Watching logs + observability. I'll alert if token errors > 1% or if kv hit-rate drops >10pp.
maya: Canary traffic policy: 10% for first 10m, then 50% if healthy. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/deploys/micro-smoke — follow the checklist under "canary micro-release".
deploy-bot: Deploy started by maya — image redwood/inference:edge-20260318 — canary=10%
omar: Smoke completed — responses look normal, p50/p90 within baseline, no errors observed. :thumbsup:
linh: KV hit-rate ~82%, batch sizes stable, no token mismatch spikes. Monitoring another 5m.
maya: Thanks. Waiting for 10m window then bump to 50%. If anyone sees anomalies call for rollback immediately.
sam: One more ask — can someone update PR #2034 changelog with the config diff? If we need to rollback I want the rollback notes ready.
omar: On it, pushed a comment to PR #2034 with the delta.
linh: Ready to bump to 50% if you give the go, maya.
maya: Bump to 50% now. I'll watch the dashboards.
deploy-bot: Canary bumped to 50% by maya.
omar: All good at 50% — ramp looks clean, metrics stable. Tagging owners in tracker.
maya: Sweet — I'll mark the deploy as complete in the tracker and close the follow-up ticket in ~30m. Thanks everyone!
